gloss: to come and go; to go back and forth

definitions.gloss: to come and go; to go back and forth; to travel between
definitions.explanation: To move repeatedly between two places, or to have regular interaction with someone involving visits in both directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{行|い}き{来|き}する⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I live going back and forth between Tokyo and Osaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}き{来|き}できるようになった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、つい⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: It was only recently that people became able to freely travel back and forth across the border.

notes:
Describes repeated movement between two points, whether physical travel or regular contact between people. The noun form ⟦{行|い}き{来|き}→行き来：14056_ikiki⟧ is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|い}き{来|き}→行き来：14056_ikiki⟧: people coming and going; foot traffic
- ⟦{行|い}き{来|き}→行き来：14056_ikiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: lots of traffic; busy
- ⟦{行|い}き{来|き}→行き来：14056_ikiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: heavy traffic
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}き{来|き}する: to come and go freely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{往復|おうふく}→往復：04111_oufuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a round trip — emphasizes a single there-and-back journey rather than repeated movement
- ⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to commute, go regularly — implies a habitual one-directional trip (e.g., to work or school)
- ⟦{出入|でい}り→出入り：06609_deiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go in and out — focuses on entering and leaving a specific place

USAGE:
Can describe both physical movement (⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{来|き}する) and social interaction (⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|い}き{来|き}→行き来：14056_ikiki⟧ meaning 'exchange of letters').
